summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of Django packages, tools, learning resources, community links, hosting options, and starter projects, maintained by Will Vincent and Jeff Triplett.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style link list rather than a software project. The Third-Party Packages section sorts Django libraries into about 35 categories such as Admin, APIs, Caching, Task Queues, Testing, Users, and Views, with a one-line description per entry. Developer Tools lists template linters and formatters and a static analysis entry, and Python Packages lists general companion libraries like black, pytest, and Pillow. Resources covers official docs, educational tutorials, conferences, job boards, newsletters, podcasts, and books. Hosting lists PaaS and IaaS providers, deployment services, and self-hosted PaaS tools, while Projects lists boilerplate starter templates and open source Django applications. Separate sections cover Django REST Framework and Wagtail resources. The README notes that the list can be browsed and searched at awesome.lvtd.dev.
use_cases: Finding a Django package for a specific need such as admin theming, caching, or background jobs
Comparing alternatives within a Django package category
Picking a Django starter template or boilerplate
Finding Django tutorials, podcasts, newsletters, and conferences
Choosing a hosting provider or self-hosted PaaS for a Django app
Discovering open source Django applications to study or self-host
notable: Organized into dozens of Django package categories, each with short one-line descriptions
Covers the whole Django ecosystem, from packages and hosting to community programs and books
Includes Django REST Framework and Wagtail sections
Lists both hosted PaaS services and self-hosted deployment tools
caveats: Link list only; it contains no installable code of its own
Entries are one-line descriptions and do not evaluate package quality or maintenance status
Some entries, such as the hosting and conference sections, may go out of date as services change
